name: Mark Hanasono
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Three

items.text: Mark Hanasono is an Associate Justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second Appellate District, Division Three. Confirmed in 2025, he was previously a Los Angeles County Superior Court judge for nearly 12 years and a public defender. He authored an opinion finding a defamation lawsuit against actress Rebel Wilson was not a SLAPP suit. He also ruled that automakers cannot enforce dealership arbitration clauses in warranty disputes.
